tasks.short: Conduct surveys and determine legal property boundaries

steps.what: Locate and read the actual deeds, titles, earlier survey plans and control references for the parcel
inputs: parcel identity supplied in the commission
available deed, title and survey archive records
outputs: surveyor-read source records and unresolved conflicts

steps.what: Plan and conduct the field survey, locate monuments and measure relevant features and control
inputs: surveyor-read source records and unresolved conflicts
actual site conditions and surveying instruments
outputs: actual field observations, measurements and monument evidence

steps.what: Reconcile field evidence with the deeds and titles and complete the checked boundary determination in the survey record
inputs: actual field observations, measurements and monument evidence
surveyor-read source records and unresolved conflicts
outputs: completed checked boundary determination with unresolved issues identified

steps.what: Save the completed boundary determination in the existing survey project
inputs: completed checked boundary determination with unresolved issues identified

tasks.design: Configure parcel-indexed retrieval in {OTHER}, the existing survey and title archive, so the surveyor can open the actual source records together. Fieldwork, interpretation of conflicting evidence and the completed boundary determination remain with the surveyor; the existing save follows completion of that record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Source records can be scattered across parcel and historic survey references.
tasks.enabler_now: Native archive indexing can shorten navigation where the required records are already accessible.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting monuments, deeds and site evidence require professional investigation.
tasks.human_edge: Determine which evidence supports the boundary and when further investigation is required.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: parcel-indexed archive retrieval can reduce navigation without determining a legal boundary.

assumptions: Shares are provisional work decomposition, not measured baselines or the prompt time prior.
OTHER means existing surveying software and authorised title/survey archives.
The commissioning party supplies the parcel identity; existing archive records are the inputs, with no invented digitisation saving.
Missing or illegible records require normal manual investigation. Existing equivalent indexing removes this proposed saving.
Gross saving is 3 hours per 100 provisional baseline hours; 0.5 hour of index upkeep gives 2.5 net. The same-system save is negligible and fully retained.
unknowns: Archive search quality and current indexing
research_questions: Does a sample of real parcel searches show repeated navigation that an existing index can remove?

already_counted.description: Read source records and resolve substantive boundary issues

incremental.description: Maintain archive references and investigate broken parcel links

approvals.approved_version: completed checked boundary determination with unresolved issues identified

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 2.5%; requires observed navigation reduction and no equivalent current index.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and certify survey maps, reports and descriptions

steps.what: Inspect actual field observations, adjusted coordinates, source plans and the boundary determination
inputs: survey crew's actual observations and project files
surveyor's actual boundary determination
outputs: checked survey source set for the deliverables

steps.what: Prepare or revise the actual sketch, map, survey report and legal description using the checked source set
inputs: checked survey source set for the deliverables
existing drawing conventions and report requirements

steps.what: Check the complete deliverable against the evidence, resolve errors and determine whether to certify the exact final version
inputs: complete draft survey deliverable version
checked survey source set for the deliverables
outputs: final survey deliverable authorised for certification

steps.what: Apply the surveyor's certification and save the authorised final deliverable in the project record
inputs: final survey deliverable authorised for certification

tasks.design: Configure existing coordinate-linked drawing objects and report fields in {OTHER}, the survey drafting application, with document templates in {DOCS}. Only known coordinates, feature codes and project facts populate those fields; the surveyor completes the narrative and certifies the final version after reviewing all deliverables.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated formatting and transcription can separate deliverables from their source survey data.
tasks.enabler_now: Native drafting and report templates can reuse checked project data deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: Certification requires defensible source interpretation and responsibility for the finished work.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when a technically consistent drawing misrepresents the evidence.

ambition.what: No increase in certified output assumed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: survey drafting systems can populate coordinate-linked drawings and standard report fields while surveyors retain certification.

assumptions: The 60% preparation share is an unmeasured scenario for the deliverables explicitly required by this task, not a measured administrative baseline.
OTHER means existing survey drafting software. Existing automatic drawing/report generation must be credited to today's workflow first.
Survey crews produce the observations in normal fieldwork; no new structured capture is assumed here.
No automatic legal interpretation or invented missing field is allowed. A source change invalidates the certification gate.
Gross provisional saving 15 minus 2 hours of template and source-link upkeep gives 13 net; certification/save remains fully retained.
Overlapping legal-description preparation must be deduplicated against the separate writing task.
unknowns: Existing templates and manual formatting effort
research_questions: Which actual drawing and report fields are still re-entered despite available native tools?

already_counted.description: Prepare remaining substantive content and perform the certification review

incremental.description: Maintain templates and test coordinate/source-field mappings

approvals.approved_version: final survey deliverable authorised for certification

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 13%; native automation may already remove most formatting and transcription.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write property boundary descriptions for legal documents

steps.what: Read the actual boundary determination, deed references, parcel identifiers and coordinate/bearing schedule
inputs: surveyor's actual resolved boundary determination
actual deed references and coordinate/bearing schedule
outputs: checked source facts for the property description

steps.what: Write the boundary description, including calls, references and necessary qualifications, and check it against the source facts
inputs: checked source facts for the property description
existing approved description format

steps.what: Save the completed checked description in the existing survey project for use in the legal document
inputs: complete checked property boundary description

tasks.design: Use native description templates in {OTHER} and {DOCS} to insert the existing checked parcel identifiers, bearings, distances and deed references. The surveyor writes qualifications and checks the complete wording; the same-system save uses that completed version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rekeying an already resolved survey schedule can introduce transcription errors.
tasks.enabler_now: Deterministic field insertion can reuse the existing survey schedule.
tasks.still_hard: The description must express the intended boundary and address ambiguous source evidence.
tasks.human_edge: Choose defensible wording for exceptions and conflicting descriptions.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: structured survey schedules can populate fixed description fields without generating the substantive boundary judgment.

assumptions: Shares and remaining fractions are provisional and unmeasured. This task already requires writing; no extra report baseline is added.
OTHER means existing survey software. Source facts come from the actual resolved survey, not a new model interpretation.
Only fixed fields are inserted; missing references stop population, and existing native insertion yields no additional saving.
Gross provisional saving 11.85 minus 1 hour of template upkeep gives 10.85 net. Same-system save is effectively instantaneous and earns no saving.
Do not count the same description again within the broader survey-deliverable task. Filing a deed or sending it is outside this writing task and is not proposed.
research_questions: Does native schedule-to-description insertion cover the actual required fixed fields?

already_counted.description: Substantive drafting and ordinary final checking of the description

incremental.description: Maintain description templates and verify changed source-field mappings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 10.85%; depends on real manual field insertion remaining today.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Inspect actual field files and instrument metadata for completeness, units, coordinate reference and observation provenance
inputs: survey crew's original instrument files and field notes
actual project control and instrument metadata
outputs: checked observation set and explicit missing-input list

steps.what: Select the appropriate adjustment, tolerances and independent control checks for this survey
inputs: checked observation set and explicit missing-input list
actual survey specification and control reliability

steps.what: Run and inspect the selected closures, residuals, adjustment calculations and tolerance comparisons
inputs: checked observation set and explicit missing-input list
surveyor-selected verification configuration
outputs: calculated verification results with source references and exceptions

steps.what: Investigate discrepancies against field evidence, decide whether remeasurement is needed and complete the checked verification finding
inputs: calculated verification results with source references and exceptions
original field notes and independent control evidence
outputs: complete checked verification finding and any remeasurement requirement

steps.what: Save the completed checked verification finding in the survey project
inputs: complete checked verification finding and any remeasurement requirement

tasks.design: Configure native import checks and repeatable adjustment/check runs in {OTHER}, the existing survey computation application. Calculations use actual observations and surveyor-selected tolerances; the surveyor investigates exceptions and finishes the verification finding before saving it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated manual selection and comparison of calculation outputs can make checks inconsistent.
tasks.enabler_now: Native survey computation tools support repeatable numerical checks without language-model arithmetic.
tasks.still_hard: A passing adjustment does not prove the monuments, control or field observations are correct.
tasks.human_edge: Diagnose systematic errors and order remeasurement when the evidence requires it.

ambition.what: No reduction in field verification assumed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: survey computation applications can calculate adjustments, closures and residual checks deterministically.

assumptions: Provisional shares describe human verification effort, not instrument or computer runtime and not measured organisation data.
Survey crews already produce the observation files and field notes; missing metadata is handled manually rather than inferred.
Credit only repeated human setup/comparison removed beyond existing adjustment software. Existing equivalent configured checks give zero additional saving.
Gross provisional saving 17 minus 2 hours of configuration/tolerance upkeep gives 15 net. Saving the finding remains 1% and fully retained.
unknowns: Existing configured checks and true human comparison effort
research_questions: Which repeated checks still require manual setup or cross-referencing on actual completed surveys?

already_counted.description: Inspect inputs/results, select checks and investigate discrepancies

incremental.description: Maintain and regression-check import mappings and verification configurations

approvals.approved_version: complete checked verification finding and any remeasurement requirement

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 15%; existing survey software and actual human workload must be measured first.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
